# Memory Kind

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:MemoryKind`](gmeow-MemoryKind.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/MemoryKind>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/ai`](../../slices/ai.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An open value vocabulary of agent-memory registers.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:MemoryKind`](gmeow-MemoryKind.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the open value vocabulary for the memory-register axis — the cognitive registers (episodic, semantic, working, procedural, …) that [`gmeow:memoryKind`](../properties/gmeow-memoryKind.md) draws from; mint a fresh individual for a register not seeded.

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting a register SUBCLASS of [`gmeow:MemoryItem`](gmeow-MemoryItem.md) (the register is a value, [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)) and avoid overloading it with salience or recency, which are statement-level facets, not registers.

### How to use

- Add a new register as a [`gmeow:MemoryKind`](gmeow-MemoryKind.md) individual with [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) and [skos:definition](http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition); reference it from a [`gmeow:MemoryItem`](gmeow-MemoryItem.md) via [`gmeow:memoryKind`](../properties/gmeow-memoryKind.md).

### Examples

- ex:memoryKindEpisodic a [`gmeow:MemoryKind`](gmeow-MemoryKind.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "episodic"@en.
